subject: Pilot timeline disruption — request for extra evaluation window
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@quantumledger.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot timeline disruption — request for extra evaluation window

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team is excited about Redwood. We hit an unexpected blocker this morning while wiring up our secure-transfer (FTPS) connector to the Redwood sandbox: our provider drops the TLS handshake intermittently and the connector retries are saturating the staging queue.

Our engineers estimate this will take ~5 business days to stabilize (we're troubleshooting with the provider), which pushes our planned alpha evaluation out of the existing trial window.

Can you help with an extra evaluation window and a small sandbox credit top-up so we can finish the integration and complete the two validation runs we promised? If needed, cc-ing our internal eng contact: Aisha Jennings (aisha.j@quantumledger.com).

Would appreciate a short confirmation either way — we want to keep momentum but don’t want to lose the pilot progress.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Integrations, QuantumLedger

Attachments: integration_log_excerpt.txt (snippet of FTPS error), sftp-error-screenshot.png
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@quantumledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-04T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline disruption — request for extra evaluation window

Hi Samir —

Really sorry to hear about the FTPS instability. We can be flexible here. Tentatively I can offer a two-week extension to the sandbox evaluation and a one-time credit top-up (we usually do token-based top-ups for pilots). I need to confirm with our internal team for the exact token amount and whether we can provide any temporary routing/ingestion workarounds while you stabilize the connector.

I'll loop in Engineering to assess the best short-term mitigation (workaround or alternate adapter) and confirm numbers by end of day tomorrow. If you'd like a formal approval note for legal/procurement, we'll produce a short PDF approval once internal sign-off is done.

Cc: Ben — heads-up in case we want to treat this as a make-good for the pilot.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor

Subject: FW: Pilot timeline disruption — need ETA on secure-transfer fix

Dylan, Marissa —

Quick context below: QuantumLedger (Samir) is seeing FTPS/TLS handshake failures when connecting to our sandbox. They estimate ~5 business days to resolve with their provider. They asked for a short extension and a top-up.

Can you advise:
- Is there a low-effort adapter fallback (S3 presigned upload / HTTP ingest) we can recommend as a temporary path?
- If we approve a two-week extension, can you confirm any SLO impact or extra costs on our side?
- Estimated internal approval for a token top-up (ballpark token amount we can offer for a pilot make-good)?

Samir attached a short log excerpt. I’ve asked him for full logs but wanted your read first.

Thanks,
Neha
(On Tue, May 4 Samir wrote: — see original message)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-05T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Pilot timeline disruption — need ETA on secure-transfer fix

Neha — quick update from eng: we can recommend an interim workflow using presigned S3 uploads to bypass the FTPS link; that should be a 2–4 hour setup for the QuantumLedger devs and avoids touching our ingestion runtime.

No impact to our SLOs if we grant the two-week extension. For token top-up, recommend ~12k token units (~$1.2k equivalent) for two validation runs at their expected traffic. I can sign off on that amount for a one-off pilot credit.

If QL wants us to stand up a temporary webhook adapter, estimate ~2 days of engineer time on our side; prefer the presigned-S3 route first.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Software Engineer, Platform

Hi Samir / Aisha —

Good news: we reviewed this internally and can approve the following as a pilot make-good:

- Sandbox evaluation extension: +14 days from your current trial expiry.
- One-time token top-up: 12,000 token units credited to your pilot account.
- Recommended interim path: presigned S3 uploads (Dylan has outlined steps below). If you want Redwood to implement a temporary webhook adapter instead, we can schedule that (estimated 2 business days; please confirm).
- Official approval note is attached (trial-extension-approval.pdf) for procurement.

Please confirm whether you want to proceed with presigned S3 or request the webhook adapter. Once you confirm, Ben and I will put the credit in and extend the sandbox window.

Apologies for the disruption — happy we could keep the pilot moving.

Best,
